entries.claim: Port/bind failures are silent on both sides. In `scripts/verify-ocr-contract.mjs`, the child is forked onto the fixed literal port 18765 with no `error`/`exit` handler, so any bind or spawn failure kills the child before `ready` and only surfaces 5s later as a generic "Mock server startup timed out" that hides the real cause. Validate the port, attach an `'error'` handler in the helper that reports the failure over IPC/stderr, and in the parent bind an ephemeral port (`0`, with the helper reporting the bound port) and race on `ready`/`error`/`exit` so failures fail fast with the actual reason.

entries.claim: The startup timeout timer is `.unref()`'d and never cleared. The `finally` block then never runs either, so the temp directory leaks and no assertion message is printed.
